image.name: sonarr
image.description: [Sonarr](https://sonarr.tv/) (formerly NZBdrone) is a PVR for usenet and bittorrent users. It can monitor multiple RSS feeds for new episodes of your favorite shows and will grab, sort and rename them. It can also be configured to automatically upgrade the quality of files already downloaded when a better quality format becomes available.

changelog.desc: Add krb5-libs for better postgresql support.
Update `develop` branch to v5. New v5 installs will write initial credentials to container log.
Bump develop branch to v4, rebase to Alpine 3.16.
Rebase master branch to mono 6.12 base (focal).
Rebase develop branch to Alpine, deprecate develop-alpine branch.
Make the paths clearer to the user.
Upgrade to Sonarr v3. Existing users are highly recommended to make a backup prior to update.
Deprecate `UMASK_SET` in favor of UMASK in baseimage, see above for more information.
Rebase to Linuxserver LTS mono version.
Add env variable for setting umask.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Multi arch images and pipeline build logic
Add inspect commands to README, move to jenkins build and push.
Switch to using inhouse mono baseimage, adds python also.
Change to mount /etc/localtime in README, thanks cbgj.
Add cd to /opt fixes redirects with althub (issue #25), make XDG config environment variable
Cleanup, changed sources to fetch binarys from. also a new baseimage.

volumes.desc: Location of TV library on disk (See note in Application setup)
Location of download managers output directory (See note in Application setup)

ports.desc: The port for the Sonarr web interface

image.title: Sonarr
image.setup_instructions: Access the webui at `<your-ip>:8989`, for more information check out [Sonarr](https://sonarr.tv/).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  sonarr:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/sonarr:latest
    container_name: sonarr
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/sonarr/data:/config
      - /path/to/tvseries:/tv #optional
      - /path/to/downloadclient-downloads:/downloads #optional
    ports:
      - 8989:8989
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=sonarr \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 8989:8989 \
  -v /path/to/sonarr/data:/config \
  -v /path/to/tvseries:/tv `#optional` \
  -v /path/to/downloadclient-downloads:/downloads `#optional` \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/sonarr:latest
